rules.justification: Contact (docs/NUMERICAL_VALIDATION.md, 'Contact mechanics'): every case of fixtures/model/contact is either an input fed unchanged to the port (positions, prescribed-displacement schedule, time step) or the output of computations whose strict-build Eigen evaluation order the port replicates (dynamic-size reductions and products, GEMV with extracted scalar factors, run-time 1x1 inner-product fallbacks, partial-pivot LU inverses, the identity GEMV of the nodal areas, assignment semantics of the upstream assembly under ContactUpstreamCompat::assembly, the explicit central-difference solid model). No transcendental function enters any compared value except pow(|t|, 3) in upstream's slip moduli of adversarial_curved3d_friction (UD-369 compat; the 450 values of the fixture are bit-identical on aarch64 macOS (Apple libm) and on x86_64 Linux (glibc); neither pow is claimed to be correctly rounded (glibc's is documented < 1 ULP, Rust's powf calls the platform libm)); otherwise square roots only; the pow of the upstream schedule is replayed from the fixture. Bit identity is the expected result; any difference is a defect. Comparison semantics: identical bit patterns (signed zeros and NaN payloads distinguished); D-046 additionally accepts default quiet NaNs differing only in the sign bit, which coincides here because no case contains a NaN (asserted by the replay).
rules.evidence: crates/akantu-contact/tests/contact_fixtures.rs observes every compared value bit-identical on aarch64 macOS and x86_64 Linux against these x86_64 strict-oracle fixtures: 6 detection cases incl. 30/60 degree rotations, moduli_tilted local moduli and node-indexed K, the 2000-step explicit_dynamic trajectory (every per-step SHA-256 digest of displacement and contact force, 8 checkpoints, final stresses), and the adversarial cases added after an independent review (probe v3, Eigen cache sizes pinned per D-050): adversarial_rot44/45/89/90, adversarial_ridge40/44/50, adversarial_curved3d (warped quadrangles, 3-D K), adversarial_curved3d_tri, adversarial_quadratic3d (error path). Variant goldens, generated on the UD-001 zero-init oracle variant (oracle/patches/variants/ud001-contact-zero-init.patch, labelled parameters.oracle_variant): explicit_friction (10000 steps: digests every 25 steps, 10 checkpoints incl. tangential tractions, final stresses) and adversarial_curved3d_friction (24 sliding steps across facet boundaries, slip moduli). An independent review regenerated the first 10 cases bit-identically and accepted the exact rule; a second review accepted the adversarial replays under this rule after regenerating all 21 cases byte-identically on the pinned oracle.
rules.reviewed_by: independent review during the port, November 2026
